prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Polonium (폴로늄) itself — the sovereign of the Polonium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a sharp, striking, intense look; porcelain-pale skin; gently long oval face; medium-sized eyes — narrow upturned eyes, outer eye corners slightly lifted; sharp angled brows; straight narrow nose; thin long lips; pale silver-grey eyes; a soft rose-red tint on the lips.
Body and hair: petite, small-framed build; a long ponytail with center-parted bangs framing the face; two-tone hair, snow white from the crown to mid-length and deep crimson below, like a white-over-red banner.
Expression: a firm, resolute look with calm, steady eyes.
Her element, carried in her design: polonium: a rare silvery metal found in July 1898 by a husband-and-wife pair of chemists in pitchblende and named for Poland, the wife's homeland then erased from the map, so the world would not forget it; so fiercely radioactive that a small piece heats itself to hundreds of degrees and makes the air around it glow blue; polonium-210 lasts only 138 days before decaying into quiet lead; it once kept a rover warm through the long lunar night.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — FANTASY
Costume: a high-fantasy royal or warrior costume — plate pauldrons or a gorget, mail or scale over a long tabard or robe, a circlet or crown, a flowing cape; metal ornament and regalia built from the traits above, subtle magical glow along the patterns.
Silhouette: angular, spiked dark plate armor and a long cape with torn edges — a sharp, menacing silhouette. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Colours: snow white, deep banner crimson, ionized pale blue glow, quiet lead grey.
Exposure (bold): her regalia opens to show skin — bare shoulders and arms between pauldron and bracer, a deep open neckline under the gorget with natural cleavage, a high slit in the tabard or robe showing the thigh; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; no corset; keep the costume above, material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: the last hidden citadel of a kingdom erased from every map: a fortress tucked into a rocky pass beyond the borders, a crimson banner bearing a white eagle kept furled and safe, a council table where the vanished borders are still drawn from memory, a secret school in the attic where its language is taught by candlelight.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: natural daylight or the world's own magical glow.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Po) and atomic number (84) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish, corset, bustle, Victorian tailoring, modern material, machinery.
